classification: Driver/tool prerequisite failure before Turbo/Vitest collection, not a Rust/engine/schema assertion failure
rawLogText:
! Corepack is about to download https://registry.npmjs.org/pnpm/-/pnpm-10.8.1.tgz
Network access disabled by the environment; can't reach https://registry.npmjs.org/pnpm/-/pnpm-10.8.1.tgz

driverCacheSetting.COREPACK_HOME: Not explicitly assigned by driver; inherited value not captured. No exact inherited-value claim.

boundedAttribution: The worker startup pnpm --version succeeded, but the later workload shim could not find its selected local pnpm10.8.1 installation. Driver cache isolation sets XDG_CACHE_HOME; Corepack falls back to XDG_CACHE_HOME/node/corepack absent explicit COREPACK_HOME. The raw request/refusal proves the selected tool cache was unavailable; the precise inherited COREPACK_HOME was not recorded. No source or fixture failure is evidenced.
missingPrerequisite: Authenticated offline pnpm10.8.1 runtime/cache made available to the isolated command environment; then ONLY the already-unrun 13-case root Turbo export schema filter remains in this finite allocation.
